name: attempt_password_reset
description: attempt_password_reset: Initiate a password reset for an employee's account on a specific system. Sends a temporary password to the employee's registered phone number. Returns success if the reset was initiated, or an error if the account is not eligible (e.g. requires in-person verification).

employee_id.description: The employee whose password should be reset (e.g. EMP048271).

target_system.description: The system where the password should be reset.
